note: ADR-0011 §3.2 and §3.3. [M] is the reissue manual of the original unit (brain/research/native-fet-n2.md). The circuit is held to ngspice on the same reduced circuit (the gate, side chain, bias taps and rest point as behavioural sources), with ngspice's own JFET (NJF level 1) and diode models, through six tone bursts (tests/spice/): every case at the standard quality's rates (4x of 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz) to spice.gr_db, but the two at the fastest attack (R55 0), whose first microseconds after the step carry the trapezoidal rule's error on R54 C27 (10 us, two steps at 176.4 kHz), to spice.fastest_attack_gr_db; eco's and high's rates reported. The processor in eco at 48 kHz is held to the circuit it wraps within 1e-7 FS (its float output). Static curve per switch position at 1 kHz (standard, 6 s settled for C9): the steepest ratio from 3 to 15 dB of reduction between the label times (1 - static.ratio_below) and (1 + static.ratio_above), the threshold rising with the ratio [M]; all buttons in reported against [M]'s description, not held (our reading of the switch's wiring; research note); standard against high within static.quality_db. Attack: t63 of the reduction on a 10 kHz burst from -60 dBFS to attack.level_dbfs at 20:1, on the circuit at 768 kHz: the fastest setting between fastest_min_us and fastest_max_us ([M]: 20 us), the slowest between slowest_min_us and slowest_max_us ([M]: 800 us; measured about a third of it, a known deviation), monotonic in the control; the step dependence and the stereo link reported (the link's halving of C22's charging rate, [M]'s 'doubled', is held in dsp_fet). Release: the control voltage's 1/e time over the control's value, (R57 + R56) C22, between network_min and network_max at 59 ms, 250 ms and 1.16 s (C9's path lengthens the slowest); the control's range against [M]'s 50 ms to 1.1 s; the reduction's two-stage recovery reported. THD+N under thd.max_pct_slowest at [M]'s condition (the slowest release, 50 Hz to 15 kHz, up to 20 dB of reduction), rising with the reduction at the fastest release; flat below threshold within response_db. Aliasing at the nominal level (-18 dBFS, input +6 dB, 4:1, about 3 dB of reduction) per quality: eco_dbc for eco, §3.2's -90 dBc for standard and high; heavier settings reported. Eco at high frequencies: a tone locked to the rate, 20:1, from the knee into about 11 dB of limiting, within eco_hf.fs4_db of standard at fs/4 and eco_hf.f8k_db at 8 kHz over its phase against the samples: eco's rectifier sees four or six samples a period and under-reads the peaks between them (documented, research note). Hot input (squares to +24 dBFS, input +24 dB): finite, the reduction no deeper than the gate's forward limit allows, the worst block (minimum of 3 runs) at most hot_block_ratio times the median block on a -60 dBFS square in the same configuration, and inside the period. Class A (channel, §3.5) on the golden configuration and on programme +12 dB at 20:1 with the fastest attack and release.
